name: workbench
description: A side pane with Git review, real PowerShell terminals and a live monitor of the servers running on localhost. Nothing else to install.

shell.title: Shell
shell.description: The PowerShell to run in terminals: a path or a command name. Empty picks pwsh (PowerShell 7) and falls back to Windows PowerShell.

loadProfile.title: Load PowerShell profile
loadProfile.description: Run your $PROFILE in each new terminal, as a normal PowerShell window does.
